top_signals.title: The Bank of England Is Moving Away From Coal
top_signals.summary: Environmental groups have been campaigning to encourage banks and other financial institutions to divest from fossil fuels for years, with efforts growing stronger since the Covid-19 pandemic and the global push to transition away from oil, gas, and coal to renewable alternatives. In June, the Bank of England quietly announced that it would no longer be accepting bonds associated with coal operations for key loan arrangements. The ban will be enforced from October. It is the latest move to encourage a shift away from thermal coal for electricity…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: U.S. lawmakers request information from DoorDash on use of Chinese AI models
top_signals.summary: The food delivery company is the latest to be asked to share details of AI use by two House committee conducting a joint investigation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
